scope: Read-only native component diagnostics; fixture connectors/owner, no DB/HTTP/OKX, no runtime change or load gate.

steady_admission.scope: Real ServiceHost/LIFE controllers with in-process fake provider; no claim of measured latency savings.

malformed_stopped_outflow_checkpoint.qualification: Controlled malformed persisted-checkpoint fixture, not observed current database corruption; invoke observe_once only, not a process restart.

drawdown_projection_dependency_failure.qualification: Injected unexpected RuntimeError in a real drawdown-status dependency, not a normal stale-price ValueError; readiness normally blocks unsafe sends independently. Does not prove a healthy engine fault in the retained load.

valuation_ready.scope: Real readiness traversal, fixture executor DTO getter; not real PositionExecutor CPU/network profiling.

held_report.scope: Real PositionHold/report methods; local cached price reads, not N+1 SQL or REST.

status_projection.scope: Real empty-core status path: capture_reporting normalization plus outer publication detach. Strict NaN handling and reference isolation are separate correctness requirements.

focused_regressions.qualification: Existing native tests rerun; not a new full suite, PostgreSQL or image/load acceptance.

diagnostic.qualification: Two controlled fault injections plus four structural count diagnostics; no OS restart or current database defect asserted.

source_boundaries.escaping_exception: run_service catches Exception as service_internal_failure and exits; supervisor replacement is inferred from source, not executed here.
source_boundaries.drawdown_scope: Full DTO readiness path matters when drawdown is enabled; the six-episode accepted baseline had drawdown/outflow flags off.
source_boundaries.freshness: Per-order and after-throttle authority/readiness remain required; duplicate traversal findings do not authorize caching or omitting them.
